practiceTest.topicName: U3.T1 Introduction to user experience and why it matters (UX honeycomb)
practiceTest.question: List any four facets of the UX honeycomb and give a one-line example of one of them from the college ERP portal.
practiceTest.examinerLooksFor: Four correct facets plus one concrete example from a real interface.

practiceTest.topicName: U3.T5 Business goals and aligning them with user goals
practiceTest.question: Give one example where a business goal of a food-delivery app conflicts with a user goal.
practiceTest.examinerLooksFor: A named business goal, a named user goal and the specific point where they clash.

practiceTest.topicName: U4.T1 Sketching principles and red routes
practiceTest.question: What is the red route of a hostel mess-feedback app? State it as a sequence of screens.
practiceTest.examinerLooksFor: Definition of red route applied to the given app as an ordered screen sequence.

practiceTest.question: How should a course-registration table change between a 1280 px laptop screen and a 360 px phone?
practiceTest.examinerLooksFor: What moves, hides or stacks at the smaller breakpoint.

practiceTest.question: Differentiate a wireframe and a wireflow with one example each.
practiceTest.examinerLooksFor: A correct distinction plus one example of each.

practiceTest.topicName: U3.T3 Research in UX design: tools and methods
practiceTest.question: The placement cell wants an app that tells final-year students which companies are visiting and lets them register. Select three UX research methods, justify each by what it reveals, and present your plan as a table (method | why | what it reveals).
practiceTest.examinerLooksFor: Three methods, each justified by what it reveals for THIS app, in a table. A list without justification is capped at 4/10.

practiceTest.topicName: U3.T5 Business goals and aligning them with user goals
practiceTest.question: A campus print-shop app earns more when students choose colour printing. Explain one concrete conflict between this business goal and student goals, and propose a resolution you can measure.
practiceTest.examinerLooksFor: One concrete conflict, one concrete resolution and a metric; generic 'balance both' gets no application marks.

practiceTest.question: Identify the red route of a library seat-booking app and draw wireframes of 3-4 screens on that route, connected as a wireflow with labelled arrows.
practiceTest.examinerLooksFor: Red route named first, 3-4 labelled wireframes, arrows labelled with the user action.

practiceTest.topicName: U3.T2 The UX design process and its methodology (double diamond)
practiceTest.question: Explain the double diamond process with a labelled diagram, using the redesign of the college bus-tracking app as a running example.
practiceTest.examinerLooksFor: Both diamonds with all four phases labelled, divergence/convergence marked, and the example carried through each phase.
